about: How DESIGNS (on the booth and the phone page) groups and orders designs. 'order': the groups, first to last. 'names': the start of a design's name (before the colon) or a gift's collection folder -> its group. 'designs': single shared designs by file (path inside frames/, no .png). Shared designs in neither are in 'other'. A design's own JSON can say "group": "..." and that wins.
